input.description: grep for RouteNotFoundException in laravel and drupal
grep for new RouteNotFoundException in laravel and drupal source
grep new RouteNotFoundException excluding vendor dirs

input.command:
for f in \
  laravel-framework/src/Illuminate/Routing/UrlGenerator.php \
  drupal/tests/Drupal/Tests/Core/Access/AccessManagerTest.php \
  drupal/tests/Drupal/Tests/Core/Routing/LazyRouteCollectionTest.php \
  drupal/lib/Drupal/Core/Routing/RouteProvider.php \
  drupal/lib/Drupal/Core/Routing/NullGenerator.php \
  drupal/modules/system/src/Tests/Routing/MockRouteProvider.php \
  drupal/modules/link/tests/src/Unit/Plugin/Validation/Constraint/LinkNotExistingInternalConstraintValidatorTest.php ; do
  echo "== $f =="
  grep -nE 'use .*RouteNotFoundException' "/Users/ethanhinson/dev/code-indexer/bench/repos/$f"
done
